patches_added.name: Grammar Check Row
patches_added.description: Force the grammar check settings row to appear. The Phenotype flag that governs it never syncs on a patched build, so its compiled-in default (off) sticks.

patches_added.name: Suggested Settings
patches_added.description: Turns on flick keys for symbols, touch & hold keys for numbers, suggestion strip, grammar check and smart replies, and turns off block offensive words and word suggestions. Written once as defaults, so each can still be changed in Gboard's own settings.

patches_added.name: Toolbar Buttons
patches_added.description: Add Select all, Copy and Paste buttons to the toolbar above the keyboard, so each is one tap instead of opening Gboard's text editing panel first. Registered natively, so drag-to-reorder through the toolbar customize page persists.

patches_added.name: Toolbar Hotkeys
patches_added.description: Adds up to twelve customisable hotkey buttons to Gboard's toolbar, each typing text the user sets in Flexboard's settings.

patches_added.name: Toolbar Native Test
patches_added.description: Add a 'Test' button to the toolbar through Gboard's own access-point registry so drag reorder and persistence work natively. Writes 'test' at the cursor on tap. Architectural proof-of-concept; off by default.

patches_removed.name: Bigger Toolbar
patches_removed.description: Makes the number of icons on the toolbar above the keyboard adjustable, from Gboard's own settings. Anything past the limit stays in the overflow menu.

patches_removed.name: Flick Keys for Symbols
patches_removed.description: Turn on Gboard's "Flick keys to enter symbols" — pull down on a key to enter the symbol hinted in its corner. Written once as a default, so it can still be turned off in Gboard's own settings.

patches_removed.name: Select All Button
patches_removed.description: Add a Select all button to the toolbar above the keyboard. One tap selects everything in the text field, without opening Gboard's text editing panel first.

patches_modified.name: Unlock Premium
patches_modified.description: Unlocks premium in Beta by Mirko by disabling the ads gate and PairIP license checks.
